Chippewa County, Minnesota
Welcome to Chippewa County's Mapping and GIS Hub!
This site provides Chippewa County's maps, apps and other resources in one single location. If you are unable to find information important to you, check out the County Webpage, or contact the Site Administrator. Your feedback is important to the development of the county's available resources.
Application Gallery
Chippewa County's featured maps, apps and other content.
PLSS Corner Viewer
View corner locations in the Public Land Survey System with document linking.
Burn Permit
The published layer for the application and tracking of Burn Permits issued for the Sheriff Department of Chippewa County, MN.
Tax Statement Lookup
The Tax Statement Lookup app can be used by the general public to access tax statements.
Floodplain Inquiry
The Floodplain Inquiry app can be used to locate property impacted by FEMA floodplain boundaries.
Land Use Permitting Applications
Chippewa County permitting solution.
Open Data
Using Open Data, you can search, explore, discover, and download Chippewa County's publicly available and authoritative data.
Featured Content
Chippewa County Website
Chippewa County's website is the community's destination for government resources.
Interactive Mapping
Land records, maps and data integrated with tax, CAMA and permitting information.
Mobile Mapping
Mobile ready land records, maps and data integrated with tax, CAMA and permitting information.
Tax Parcel Viewer
The Tax Parcel Viewer app can be used by the general public to access tax parcels and related assessment information.
